newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec eases off record on oil find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec eases off record on oil find.

text.p: Shares in oil producer Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd (PetSec) eased off the record high it hit after it discovered more oil in the Gulf of Mexico offshore the United States.
At 1.30 p.m. (0230 GMT), PetSec shares were 40 cents or 6.4 percent up at A$6.65 on light volume, but just off the record high of A$6.75 hit earlier in afternoon trade.

PetSec shares have been one of the strongest performers on the Australian Stock Exchange over the past year, with a doubling of its share price over the past 12 months to give a current market capitialisation of about A$710 million.
